title.narrative: Procurement of Goods for Humanitarian Support in Ukraine

description.narrative:
In response to urgent need, the Korean government has decided to carry out a pilot on-site delivery of part of the humanitarian supplies requested by the Ukrainian government as part of its humanitarian assistance, through the cooperation between KOICA and UNOPS.

The project objective number one is to cover the needs in means of transportation for school students from remote areas of Sumy oblast to ensure their access to schooling in the face-to-face format. The second objective of the project is to enhance the resilience of the State Emergency Service of Ukraine (SESU) to possible electricity outages through procurement of large capacity generators for its regional facilities in different locations all over Ukraine. As first responders, SESU divisions need uninterrupted power supply to properly perform their functions which cannot be ensured through the use of small and medium capacity generators.
